top_signals.title: EU Roma Strategic Framework brings positive progress on Roma rights across the EU with further efforts needed
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 The European Commission has published the third implementation report on the EU Roma Strategic Framework, covering the period from June 2023 to March 2025.
